articles.title: ITCONS E-Solutions bags order worth Rs 83 lakh
articles.summary: ITCONS E-Solutions has secured an Rs 83.05 lakh manpower outsourcing services contract from the Indian Navy, Ministry of Defence. This deal highlights the Indian Armed Forces' increasing collaboration with the private sector for essential operational support and efficiency. For SSB aspirants, it demonstrates how external partnerships enhance defence capabilities and the broader ecosystem supporting national security.

articles.title: Allison Janney Wins Emmy for Supporting Actress in Drama, Tying Record for Most Wins by a Performer
articles.summary: Allison Janney, known for her role in "The Diplomat," recently earned her eighth career Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actress in a Drama Series. This significant achievement places her among television's most celebrated performers, as she now ties the all-time record for Emmy wins by an actress. Her remarkable career continues to be recognized for excellence.

articles.title: Andy Burnham delays ordering new submarines for TWO years despite global threats
articles.summary: Andy Burnham has reportedly postponed new submarine orders for two years, despite existing global threats. This decision could impact national defence capabilities and strategic readiness, a critical aspect for SSB aspirants to understand regarding maritime security. It highlights the balance between political decisions and defence preparedness in a dynamic global environment.

articles.title: Indian government reveals new system able to detect Chinese-made components in military drones
articles.summary: The Indian Army has inaugurated a new lab to uncover hidden vulnerabilities in drones, particularly those utilizing Chinese-origin components. This initiative, supported by AASHVAST technicians, aims to identify potential backdoors and weaknesses. It strengthens national security protocols by ensuring operational integrity against sophisticated threats, underscoring the Army's commitment to modern warfare preparedness and safeguarding critical defence assets from exploitation.
